Every device shows the browser's certificate warning once. To avoid it, install the certificate authority on the device (compare its fingerprint first). It can only vouch for local names and private addresses.
How to install the certificate authority
open the download in Safari, install it in Settings › General › VPN & Device Management, then turn on full trust in Settings › General › About › Certificate Trust Settings.
Settings › Security › Encryption & credentials › Install a certificate › CA certificate.
open the file › Install Certificate › Local Machine › Trusted Root Certification Authorities.
open it in Keychain Access (System) and set Trust to Always Trust.
Extra names and addresses for the certificate
Names from TLS_HOSTNAMES: none. Saving makes a new certificate and asks for your password.
